title: 连接禅道
description: 密码与 Token 至少填写一项，同时填写时优先使用 Token。凭据由 WorkBuddy 保存在本机。
description_en: Enter a password or Token. Token takes precedence when both are provided. WorkBuddy stores your credentials locally.

fields.label: 禅道地址
fields.description: 填写站点根地址；部署在子目录时保留子目录。
fields.description_en: Enter the site URL, including its subdirectory when applicable.

fields.label: 密码
fields.description: 自动换取 Token；已有 Token 时可留空。
fields.description_en: Automatically obtains a Token. Leave empty if you already have a Token.

fields.label: Token
fields.description: 填写已有 Token 时可留空密码。
fields.description_en: Use an existing Token instead of a password.
